title.en: Local reflection and probe spatial scope

summary: Choose and label the spatial approximation for local reflections or diffuse irradiance: global environment, positioned cubemap capture, diffuse probe or supported probe grid, without promising automatic GI or portable box projection.
objective: Reflective objects change plausibly across declared zones, capture updates are controlled, and unsupported local parallax or diffuse-GI features fail visibly instead of being implied.
applies_when: A global environment looks stuck or spatially wrong inside rooms or vehicles.
Blender EEVEE probes inspire a Three.js runtime solution.
intent_signals: distinguish diffuse probe from reflection capture
example_prompts: Give two adjacent rooms distinct reflection captures and show the transition volume.
Use CubeCamera for a hero object while proving the object is excluded during capture.
negative_signals: Calling LightProbe a local specular reflection cubemap.
Assuming Blender probe influence/parallax objects export into a core Three.js scene.
not_for: Global IBL and direct-shadow ownership already covered by the related record.

principles: A global environment is a broad directional approximation. Local specular capture requires a declared capture position, influence/blend rule and update policy; a diffuse LightProbe is a different representation.
Blender EEVEE Sphere probes have local influence and optional parallax volumes, but those authoring constructs are references unless an explicit adapter recreates them at runtime.

Box projection is capability gated. Do not claim it as an automatic core Three.js feature; record renderer backend, Three.js revision and the exact supported implementation or diagnose absence. No probe automatically supplies complete dynamic GI.
implementation: In Blender, author probe-reference bounds around coherent spaces and capture neutral/chrome references; record which geometry and emitter state the probe saw.

In Three.js, choose global envMap, a positioned CubeCamera capture, diffuse LightProbe, or supported LightProbeGrid deliberately. Exclude the receiving hero from its own cubemap capture and update only on declared invalidation.
Visualize capture points and zone bounds; compare a chrome sphere and diffuse card at center, boundary and outside each zone.
observable_checks: A translated chrome reference changes consistently between zones rather than reflecting one global position everywhere.
Diffuse LightProbe changes the diffuse card but is not presented as a specular cubemap; CubeCamera changes reflections at its capture point.
Unsupported box projection produces an explicit capability result. No capture recursively contains its receiving object, and static update policy shows stale state when deliberately invalidated.

creative_affordances: Use rooms, display cases, vehicle cabins or portals with sharply different reflection identities.
Make probe boundaries inspectable through wire volumes or a movable reference sphere.
known_limits: Cubemap capture is exact only at its capture position; parallax and occlusion errors remain.
Current LightProbeGrid documentation is WebGLRenderer-only and describes diffuse irradiance, not specular reflection.
No probe bake, cube capture, renderer capability or visual comparison was run.

claims.statement: Blender EEVEE Sphere probes record incoming light at one location, have local sphere/box influence, and can use a separately fitted custom parallax volume.
claims.scope: Current Blender EEVEE authoring reference; no interchange claim.

claims.statement: Three.js CubeCamera captures surroundings from one 3D position into a cube render target usable as an environment map; its example hides the receiving object during update.
claims.scope: Current local cubemap mechanism, without volume blending or box projection guarantee.

claims.statement: Three.js LightProbe stores spherical-harmonic irradiance for diffuse approximation and does not emit; the current LightProbeGrid addon provides position-dependent diffuse GI and is documented as WebGLRenderer-only.
claims.scope: Current Three.js diffuse probe APIs, distinct from local specular cubemaps.
